risks.title: Spend with suppliers above the quote tier that has no matching contract notice
risks.description: Indicator that suppliers above the quote tier may lack the contract or quote evidence the rules expect.

likelihood.justification: Two indicator tests fire: {{$.tests.off_contract.count}} suppliers have no matching notice [metric:$.tests.off_contract.count] and {{$.tests.split_purchases.counts}} supplier episodes cross a tier [metric:$.tests.split_purchases.counts]. The prior audit of the same theme gave a Limited Assurance opinion [history:OP-12].

repeat_finding.note: same theme: direct payments and care purchasing controls

impact.justification: Annualised spend without a notice is {{$.tests.off_contract.annualised_estimate_gbp|gbp}}, above the Major band's financial scale, and the quote rule is mandatory [rule:CPR-59] [metric:$.tests.off_contract.annualised_estimate_gbp].

risks.proposed_focus: Request contract and quote evidence for the highest-value suppliers without a notice.
